name: solute carrier family 27 member 5

function.text: SLC27A5 is the approved symbol for solute carrier family 27 member 5. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in cholate-CoA ligase activity; long-chain fatty acid transmembrane transporter activity; bile acid and bile salt transport.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: SLC27A5 encodes solute carrier family 27 member 5. Its functions include cholate-CoA ligase activity and long-chain fatty acid transmembrane transporter activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLC27A5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
